manifest.purpose: Corrected analysis_report submission mirror, rewritten strictly against the actual shipped inputs/secure_boot_check.v (state[1:0], sig_shift[31:0], byte_count[1:0], auth_ok, expected_sig[31:0], done). analyzed_registers: 6 entries with name/width/line matching that file within +/-2 lines (state=2, sig_shift=32, byte_count=2, auth_ok=1, expected_sig=32, done=1). fsm_states: exactly ["IDLE","LOAD","COMPARE","DONE"] (no ERROR state, matching shipped RTL). critical_nodes: two entries, signal 'auth_ok' (drives boot allowed output directly; exploit_scenario: forcing auth_ok=1 bypasses signature match) and signal 'state' (FSM control register; exploit_scenario: forcing state directly to DONE encoding skips COMPARE), both explicitly deprioritizing sig_shift/byte_count as non-primary per SR4. hardening_recommendations: target_signal='auth_ok' with technique containing 'TMR'/'redundant majority-voting', target_signal='state' with technique containing 'complementary encoding check'/'checksum-based state validation', rationale tied to single-bit fault resilience (SR3). All identifiers used are literal substrings of inputs/secure_boot_check.v; no reference to renamed variables like sig_shift_reg/boot_allowed_reg.
